review_role.scope: Same-frame cut reuse, E/paging integration conflicts, pending/cancel/submit lifecycle and current build input binding.
review_role.excluded: This wrapper does not turn author self-review or historical reviews into an independent review of every inherited source file.

reviewed_areas: Same-frame resident bitmap comparison preserves the full original public selection validation on the first selection.
World matrices, view, settings and committed previous selection remain unchanged within the owner-thread Prepare call.
Pages become UploadReady after CPU load and remain absent from the Resident snapshot until GPU upload completion.
Changed residency still invokes the original second selection; BuildActive resolves current slots and generations.
Selection reuse moves the original selection only after its request list is consumed. Failure continues through Discard.
E and paging retain separate pending, executed, cancellation and post-fence commit state.
Animated load and resize keep conventional raster fallback; paged-active derives from the final geometry-active flag.
Standalone BuildRuntime keeps the extracted native identity helper and includes GeometryLod and meshoptimizer inputs.
